stories.title: Around 2,000 metric tons of wheat shipped from Russia to Armenia via Azerbaijan
stories.summary: BAKU, August 19. Russia has exported another shipment of grain to Armenia in transit through Azerbaijan, the state-run Azertac news agency reported. According to the agency, the shipment includes 1,820 metric tons of wheat. In late October last year, Azerbaijan lifted its ban on the transit of goods bound for Armenia through its territory. Since then, a total of up to 43,000 metric tons of Russian grain, around 9,000 metric tons of fertilizers, 1,136 metric tons of propane, 1,114 metric tons of coal, 133 metric tons of aluminum, and 67 metric tons of timber have been exported from Russia to Armenia in transit through Azerbaijan.
